title: Polynomial advice class inclusion
statement: For all natural numbers $c,C,d$, every language decidable with advice of length $C(n+1)^d$ in time bounded by a constant multiple of $n^c+1$ belongs to the class of languages decidable with polynomially bounded advice and polynomial time.
